description.value: Baik Mi Korean Restaurant is a Korean eatery on Fraser Highway in Surrey that has been operating since at least 2012, serving dishes including Jjambong (spicy seafood soup), Jjang sauce, and Kkan Pung Gi (fried chicken). Run by operator Moon Young Jang, the restaurant has maintained a current 'Low' hazard rating through regular Fraser Health Authority inspections. A touring cyclist passing through Surrey's commercial strip along Fraser Highway will find a sit-down Korean meal at this long-established local restaurant.

The FHA records consistently list the phone as (604) 278-0788, which differs from the OSM value of +1-778-278-0788 (different area code); no restaurant-owned website was available so all cyclist-specific amenities remain null.
